sequencing_rule: Do not collapse manufacturing, characterization, tensile testing, and independent replication into one evidence source when separable routes are available.
Use quote/scoping responses to refine the preregistration before protected parameters are disclosed.
Do not label a route ENGAGED until a facility affirmatively accepts scoping or work.
Do not label a campaign SCHEDULED until scope, method, sample/device requirements, cost/authorization path, and evidence-return terms are mutually understood.
No route may promote scientific maturity before calibrated raw evidence is ingested and reviewed under PVK.
